title: HELIX Terminology: Pay Frequency
description: How often compensation is disbursed to employees.

codes.definition: Paid every two weeks (26 pay periods per year). Most common for hourly/non-exempt staff in higher education. Creates occasional three-paycheck months.
Paid twice per month, typically on the 1st and 15th or 15th and last day (24 pay periods per year). Common for exempt staff at some institutions.
Paid once per month (12 pay periods per year). Most common for faculty and senior administrators. 9-month faculty may receive pay over 9 or 12 months depending on election.
Paid every week (52 pay periods per year). Less common in higher ed; used at some institutions for temporary and student workers.
Single payment for the full appointment period. Used for some fellowship stipends, one-time consulting arrangements, or athletic bonuses.
Compensation calculated and paid per course taught. Standard for adjunct faculty. Payment schedule varies: lump sum at term start, split across term pay periods, or paid at term end.
